description: Single and two storey side to rear extension; roof light in front roof slope; external alterations
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">Reasonable
Exemption Statement; Location Plan, Existing Floor Plans Page 1 of 6 REV 1, Proposed
Floor Plans Page 2 of 6 REV 1, Existing Elevations Page 3 of 6 REV 1, Proposed
Elevations Page 4 of 6 REV 1, Flood Risk Assessment (dated 23/06/2026)</span>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
<p>Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, roof of the extended first floor shall be finished with a ridge tile detail to surround the flat topped crown roof element.&nbsp;</p>
